title: Episode 3 - Sone ka laddoo
end_card:
पार्ट 4 कल!
दिवाली में 8 दिन बाकी

shots.visual: Evening at the banyan tree shrine. A glowing golden laddoo sits on a decorated pedestal under a soft spotlight of warm light, with village animals gathered around in awe. Chikki stands in front of it, magnifying glass in hand, speaking firmly to the crowd.
shots.camera: slow reveal of the glowing golden laddoo, then medium shot of Chikki

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: ये है सोने का लड्डू, पूरे साल की खुशियाँ इसी में हैं! आज रात मैं खुद इसकी रखवाली करूँगी!

shots.visual: Chikki points at the gate and assigns guard duty. Bhola looks alarmed and scratches his head. Kallu lands next to him with a helpful, innocent face while his eyes dart toward the golden laddoo.
shots.camera: medium three-shot, Chikki pointing, Bhola nervous, Kallu close

lines.speaker: bhola
lines.hi: पर मैं तो सो जाता हूँ!

shots.visual: Deep night, bright moon. Bhola is snoring loudly at the gate. Kallu is no longer next to him. Chikki hides behind a pot, whispering to Chulbul who is slumped sleepily against the pot with his cap over his eyes. In the background a dark shape slips across the shrine toward the pedestal.
shots.camera: wide moonlit shot, slow push toward Chikki and Chulbul while a dark shape crosses behind them

shots.visual: Cliffhanger. Dawn. Chikki lifts the golden laddoo from the pedestal, it feels light, and it cracks in her paw, revealing plain besan inside with golden paint flaking off. Chikki is shocked. Bhola wakes up, sleepy, with golden flakes on his tongue. Chikki slowly turns toward Bhola, eyes narrowing, while Kallu gasps dramatically behind him.
shots.camera: close-up of the laddoo cracking open, then slow push in on Chikki's narrowed eyes, then Bhola's guilty face

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: ये तो नकली है! असली लड्डू कहाँ गया?

lines.speaker: bhola
lines.hi: मैंने तो... बस एक बार चाटा था!
